about_the_game:
Message from the Developer:
Welcome to the challenging journey of the game.
I’m sure you already know W, A, S, D, space, and sprint — but I’ll remind you anyway.
Due to the game’s intense difficulty, we’ve made a few adjustments and slight easings.
You might think something is a bug, but trust me — everything is intentionally placed.
And yes… the game is fully completable.
Now, are you truly ready?

For any situation, feel free to contact us at ssyphusgames@gmail.com.

Overview

"UP" is a fast-paced platformer that challenges your reflexes, jumping skills, climbing ability, and quick decision-making. In this vertical world filled with towering structures and dangerous platforms, you have only one goal: go up.

With mechanics that are easy to learn but hard to master, UP delivers a sense of growth and mastery step by step. Whether you're a speedrunner or a strategic thinker, you'll face increasingly difficult challenges as you climb. Timing, direction, and jump angles will determine your success.

Key Features

🟢 Reflex-Based Parkour Mechanics
Fast and fluid movement system including jumping, platforming, and quick navigation.

🟡 Endless Ascent in a Vertical World
Each level pushes you higher. How far can you climb?

🔴 Deadly Traps and Challenging Obstacles
Watch your step! Hidden traps and moving platforms will test your reflexes.

🔵 Minimalist and Aesthetic Design
Clean yet striking visuals keep you focused on the atmosphere and action.

Ready? Jump, climb, ascend... and never fall. Because in this world, there’s only one way: UP.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4160
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 730 / AMD Radeon R7 240
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX

short_description: The UP game challenges players with adrenaline-packed, intense courses! Featuring steep climbs, narrow paths, and surprising obstacles, these tracks push your skills and endurance to the limit. Are you ready?
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Simplified Chinese, Polish, Russian, Turkish
